exposure: first stage of labor (cervical dilation = 6 cm)
second stage of labor (cervical dilation = 10 cm)
outcome: neonatal composite morbidity (cord blood pH ≤ 7.10 and/or neonatal intensive care unit admission and/or Apgar score at 5 min <7)
cohort: 948 women with SGA neonates and 948 women with appropriate weight for gestational age (AGA) neonates who delivered a singleton during labor in cephalic presentation after 37 weeks of gestation between January 2016 and December 2018
finding: STV decrease during term labor is associated with fetal well-being, independently of fetal weight.
